scope: Text and voice conversation revision. No application deployment, model change, paid-service activation or Firebase production data write.
changes: One conversation voice (Aoede) and shared pt-BR style across streaming, message reading and existing literal fallback; old voice selectors and device-conversation speech removed.
NDJSON PCM for /api/tts begins playback from first received blocks, with existing JSON/WAV compatibility, bounded payloads, cancellation and backpressure.
Provider interaction.completed terminates TTS without waiting for an idle HTTP connection EOF.
Replay preparation is announced immediately and can be cancelled before audio; generation tokens reject callbacks from former reads.
Client streaming has 75s total network and 30s packet-idle deadlines; successful network completion does not cut scheduled audio.

New guest-session receipt accepts an already explicit adult declaration and removes one serialized request; older servers retain the previous flow and every protected request still checks current authorization.
Chat phases and numeric Server-Timing distinguish preparation/generation/validation; voice processing stages and numeric timing preserve content privacy.
Adult instructions prioritize direct answers and context without repetitive greetings or a rigid twenty-word voice ceiling; factual safety grounding and checks remain.
Recent history is JSON escaped within existing pair/byte budgets; provider cancellation discards late JSON responses.
Supported minimal text-model thinking is explicit; this was already the model default and is not a measured speed-up.

limits: New code is not deployed. New-version real text latency, live microphone recognition, audible quality and physical-device UX remain unverified.
Free Render may spin down after 15 idle minutes and take about one minute to restart. Code changes do not eliminate that hosting behavior; the baseline does not prove a cold start.
No guarantee of immediate responses, the objectively best voice, or perfect factual correctness is made.
Normal literal TTS can stream; existing validation-first alternative still waits for verified literal transcript when required.
Explicit device reading in Aprender/Ajuda remains outside the conversation. The conversation does not offer a second voice or silently switch to device synthesis.
API Server-Timing begins at Express middleware and excludes network, browser and pre-Express startup time. Emergency shortcut and guard failures may not contain handler timings.
Source publication uses the previously authorized public GitHub review branch. Production deployment remains separate.
